# ChenBridge

> ChenBridge is a China packaging sourcing representative based in Suzhou, China. It helps global companies source packaging from China with local coordination, supplier development, and production follow-up. Focus areas: industrial packaging, corrugated/paper packaging, and custom packaging solutions.

## What ChenBridge does

ChenBridge acts as a local sourcing partner in China for overseas buyers. Core services:

- [Industrial Packaging](https://chenbridge.com/packaging-industrial.html): Sourcing support for industrial packaging needs.
- [Paper & Corrugated Packaging](https://chenbridge.com/packaging-paper.html): Paper-based and corrugated packaging sourcing.
- [Custom Packaging](https://chenbridge.com/packaging-custom.html): Custom packaging development with Chinese manufacturers.
- [Packaging Solutions](https://chenbridge.com/packaging-solutions.html): Overview of packaging solution services.
- [Supplier Development](https://chenbridge.com/supplier-development.html): Finding, evaluating, and developing packaging suppliers in China.
- [Procurement Support](https://chenbridge.com/procurement-support.html): Support for purchasing and order management.
- [Production Coordination](https://chenbridge.com/production-coordination.html): On-the-ground production follow-up and quality coordination.
- [Product Catalogs](https://chenbridge.com/products/paper/): Browse packaging products by category — paper, industrial, custom retail, and solutions.
